About Us

An engineering team combining electronics, control and software.

An engineering partner, not just a supplier

Jtech Mechatronics and AI Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is led by Managing Director Pejjai Janardhan Reddy and based in Hyderabad. We combine electronics, control engineering and software so one team can take a product or plant system from idea to commissioning.

Every project starts with a conversation about your actual requirement.

From first call to working system

A short, clear process so you always know what happens next.

  1. Discuss

    Tell us the problem. We ask about the process, the site and your constraints.

  2. Design

    We propose the architecture, hardware and scope, with a written quotation.

  3. Build and test

    Panels, boards and software are built and tested before they reach your site.

  4. Commission and support

    We install, hand over and stay available for service and troubleshooting.
